description: List water systems with at least one PFAS detection under EPA UCMR5 occurrence monitoring (2023-2025), worst first by maximum detected concentration. Filter by state, by county (requires state), or by a single analyte (e.g. PFOA, PFOS) to rank by that analyte's maximum. Only systems sampled under UCMR5 can appear; absence means not sampled, not PFAS-free.

analyte.description: UCMR5 analyte name, e.g. PFOA, PFOS, PFHxS, PFBS

county.description: County name as reported to SDWIS, e.g. COOK (requires state)

name: list_systems_with_pfas_detections
